fusions.name: Rising Swell
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted line that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and knocking the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You gain +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Steady Keel
fusions.desc: After you have moved far enough, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
